pick_reading_list.description: Keeps the first 5 Microsoft Learn search results, each reduced to its title and link.

read_repo_outline.description: Calls the deepwiki read_wiki_structure tool for the repository and returns the wiki outline as text, as a string.

search_microsoft_learn.description: Searches Microsoft Learn with the topic as the search text and returns the tool's decoded result, an object whose results array holds the matching articles with title and contentUrl.

write_digest.description: Builds the markdown digest with a Reading list section of linked titles and a Repo outline section holding the wiki outline as returned.

output_fields.description: Markdown document with Reading list and Repo outline sections

digest.description: Markdown document with Reading list and Repo outline sections
